value.rationale: Natural exact maximum of automorphism-group order over all simple n-dimensional algebras over the smallest field; motivated by a current maximum-order problem. Field size forces a sharp parity transition and exceptional n=3, and explicit extremizers show the bounds are exact for every n. This is an infinite structural classification of an invariant, not an arbitrary isolated computation.
